en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival opens next Thursday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department display runs from 17 to 27 September, with lighting from 6.30pm to 11pm and an extended midnight close on Mid-Autumn night.
body: The annual Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park will open on 17 September and continue until 27 September, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department said.

Lanterns will be lit from 6.30pm to 11pm each evening, extending to midnight on 25 September, the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival. Admission is free. The display features designs inspired by Hong Kong daily life and culinary culture, together with traditional craft elements.

A Mid-Autumn creative market will operate during the lighting hours. Live broadcasts of the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance are scheduled on selected evenings, and the dragon itself will appear at the park on 25 September. Visitors are advised that temporary crowd measures may be applied at peak times.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會下周四起開放
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會於9月17至27日舉行，每晚6時半至11時亮燈，中秋夜延長至午夜，免費入場。
body: 康樂及文化事務署將於9月17日至27日在維多利亞公園舉行中秋綵燈會，以香港特色及飲食文化為主題，結合傳統燈彩工藝。
綵燈每晚6時30分至11時亮起，中秋夜（9月25日）延長至午夜。入場免費。期間設有中秋創意市集。
部分晚上會直播大坑舞火龍，火龍亦會於9月25日現身維園。主辦單位提醒市民高峰時段或會實施臨時人流管制，建議錯峰到訪。
